name: Yamaha MT-10 / FZ-10
engine: 998 cc liquid-cooled crossplane inline four, fuel injected
intro: The naked R1. 2017-2020 bikes are in a front brake switch recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2017-2020 MT-10 and FZ-10 bikes are in recall 20V814 for the front brake switch.
A-002.reason: A failed switch can leave you without a brake light. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Front brake switch can fail from silicon oxide buildup, so the brake light may not work.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front brake switch free.
